update_every.title: Update every
update_every.description: Periodic metric collection interval in seconds. This does not control the standalone ceph-exporter 5-second default refresh or the ceph-mgr Prometheus 15-second default cache refresh.

autodetection_retry.title: Detection retry
autodetection_retry.description: Recheck interval in seconds. Zero disables retries.

function_only.title: Function-only mode
function_only.description: Run only on-demand Functions. Every collect toggle must be false.

url.title: Dashboard URL
url.description: Base URL of the Ceph Dashboard API. Standby-to-active MGR redirects are resolved securely.

not_follow_redirects.title: Reject redirects
not_follow_redirects.description: Reject every Dashboard redirect instead of using Ceph active-MGR discovery.

allowed_redirect_origins.title: Trusted active-MGR origins
allowed_redirect_origins.description: Exact scheme and host origins that may receive Dashboard login credentials or bearer tokens after credentialless active-MGR discovery. The configured URL origin is always trusted implicitly.

vnode.title: Vnode
vnode.description: Associate this once-per-cluster job with a configured Virtual Node. Functions remain attached to the physical Agent job.

username.title: Dashboard username
username.description: Username sent in the Ceph Dashboard JSON login request. This is not HTTP Basic authentication.

password.title: Dashboard password
password.description: Password sent only in the Ceph Dashboard JSON login request.

bearer_token_file.title: Bearer token file
bearer_token_file.description: Path to an externally managed Dashboard bearer token. Takes priority over username/password and is reread for every request.

collect.title: Periodic metric features
collect.description: All legacy overlapping or potentially heavy metric features default off. Enabling any /api/health/minimal child still incurs that complete Ceph endpoint.

dashboard_api_status.title: Dashboard API status
dashboard_api_status.description: Probe the cheap cluster-FSID endpoint and chart Dashboard API/auth/active-MGR reachability.

health_status.title: Cluster health status
health_status.description: Collect the high-level HEALTH_OK/WARN/ERR status from /api/health/minimal.

hosts.title: Host count
hosts.description: Collect the Dashboard host count from /api/health/minimal.

osds_summary.title: OSD summary
osds_summary.description: Collect cluster OSD count and up/down/in/out totals from /api/health/minimal.

managers.title: Manager count
managers.description: Collect active and standby MGR counts from /api/health/minimal.

iscsi_gateways.title: iSCSI gateway status
iscsi_gateways.description: Collect iSCSI gateway counts and status from /api/health/minimal. This may trigger synchronous gateway checks in Ceph.

objects.title: Object health
objects.description: Collect logical object totals and Ceph-native copy/unfound health ratios from /api/health/minimal.

pools_summary.title: Pool count
pools_summary.description: Collect the cluster pool count from /api/health/minimal.

pgs.title: PG summary
pgs.description: Collect placement-group totals, per-OSD ratio, and compatibility status categories from /api/health/minimal.

client_io.title: Client I/O
client_io.description: Collect cluster client throughput and operation rates from /api/health/minimal.

scrub_status.title: Scrub status
scrub_status.description: Collect the cluster scrub scheduler status from /api/health/minimal.

osds.title: Per-OSD metrics
osds.description: Collect paginated per-OSD status, capacity, I/O, IOPS, and latency from /api/osd. Selector and cap apply.

pools.title: Per-pool metrics
pools.description: Collect per-pool capacity, object, I/O, and IOPS metrics from /api/pool?stats=true. Selector and cap apply.

osd_selector.title: OSD selector
osd_selector.description: Simple-pattern selector matched against osd.<id> or OSD UUID before the cap.

max_osds.title: Maximum OSDs
max_osds.description: Maximum selected OSDs with individual charts. Overflow is represented by one aggregate other entity with additive capacity and rates plus mean latency; binary per-OSD status is omitted. This bounds Netdata cardinality, not the complete Dashboard OSD response or supported cluster size.

pool_selector.title: Pool selector
pool_selector.description: Simple-pattern selector matched against pool names before the cap.

max_pools.title: Maximum pools
max_pools.description: Maximum selected pools with individual charts. Overflow object counts are represented by one aggregate other entity; non-additive capacity and cumulative I/O are omitted. This bounds Netdata cardinality, not the complete Dashboard pool response.

functions.title: On-demand Functions
functions.description: Bounded live RCA and inventory tables. They issue Dashboard requests only while queried.

health.title: Health details
health.description: Detailed health checks, slow operations, scrub errors, and RCA messages from /api/health/minimal. Dashboard still builds every permission-dependent health section; iSCSI read scope can trigger gateway pings.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Function timeout in seconds. Zero inherits the job HTTP timeout.

limit.title: Row limit
limit.description: Maximum rows returned by the Function.

osds.title: OSD inventory
osds.description: Paginated OSD state, topology, capacity, rates, and latency.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Function timeout in seconds. Zero inherits the job HTTP timeout.

limit.title: Row limit
limit.description: Maximum rows returned by the Function.

pools.title: Pool policy
pools.description: Pool replication/EC, PG, CRUSH, application, and quota policy.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Function timeout in seconds. Zero inherits the job HTTP timeout.

limit.title: Row limit
limit.description: Maximum rows returned by the Function.

daemons.title: Daemon inventory
daemons.description: Orchestrator-backed daemon inventory. Returns a Function-local error when no orchestrator is available.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Function timeout in seconds. Zero inherits the job HTTP timeout.

limit.title: Row limit
limit.description: Maximum rows returned by the Function.

rgw_multisite.title: RGW multisite
rgw_multisite.description: Opt-in realm/zonegroup/zone inventory and best-effort sync diagnostics. It invokes radosgw-admin on the active MGR.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Function timeout in seconds. Zero inherits the job HTTP timeout.

limit.title: Row limit
limit.description: Maximum rows returned by the Function.

rgw_quotas.title: RGW quotas
rgw_quotas.description: Opt-in cached/asynchronous usage and quota data for explicit identities only.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Function timeout in seconds. Zero inherits the job HTTP timeout.

limit.title: Row limit
limit.description: Maximum rows returned by the Function.

users.title: RGW users
users.description: Explicit rgw users to query. The collector never enumerates all identities.

buckets.title: RGW buckets
buckets.description: Explicit rgw buckets to query. The collector never enumerates all identities.

accounts.title: RGW accounts
accounts.description: Explicit rgw accounts to query. The collector never enumerates all identities.

force_http2.title: Force HTTP/2
force_http2.description: Force HTTP/2, including h2c over plain TCP.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Additional HTTP headers. Authorization, Cookie, and Host are managed by the collector and rejected here.

tls_skip_verify.title: Skip TLS verification
tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate and hostname verification. This is insecure and defaults on only for compatibility with self-signed Ceph Dashboard deployments.

tls_ca.title: TLS CA
tls_ca.description: Absolute path to a CA bundle.

tls_cert.title: TLS certificate
tls_cert.description: Absolute path to a client certificate.

tls_key.title: TLS key
tls_key.description: Absolute path to a client private key.

bearer_token_file.ui:help: The token is sent only after credentialless active-MGR discovery and takes priority over Dashboard JSON login.

autodetection_retry.ui:help: How often Netdata retries a job that failed its initial Dashboard/API check. Zero disables retries.
